title: Desingularizing along a strictly standard element
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra and $\pi\in R$ with $\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi^2)$ and $\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi^2)$. Let $A\to\Lambda$ and $D\to\Lambda$ be homomorphisms of $R$-algebras with $A$ and $D$ of finite presentation over $R$. Assume (1) $\pi$ (its image in $A$) is strictly standard in $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element], and (2) there is a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $A/\pi^4A\to D/\pi^4D$ compatible with the maps to $\Lambda/\pi^4\Lambda$ induced by $A\to\Lambda$ and $D\to\Lambda$. Then there are an $R$-algebra $B$ of finite presentation, a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $B\to\Lambda$, and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $A\to B$ and $D\to B$ whose composites with $B\to\Lambda$ are the given maps $A\to\Lambda$ and $D\to\Lambda$, such that $H_{D/R}B\subset H_{B/D}$ and $H_{D/R}B\subset H_{B/R}$, where $H_{D/R}$, $H_{B/D}$, $H_{B/R}$ are the singular ideals [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] and $H_{D/R}B$ is the ideal of $B$ generated by the image of $H_{D/R}$.
